hero.title: Hero
hero.changeNote: Your level stays yours: changing hero resets nothing.
hero.retakeNote: The result doesn't lock anything: you can always change hero by hand.

quiz.zero: A perfectly balanced result: here are three heroes, you choose.

intro.s1Title: A companion, not a to-do list
intro.s1Body: Your hero has a voice, a story and a personality. It grows with you, quest after quest.
intro.s2Body: Pick daily, weekly and monthly goals. Every completion gives XP and levels you up.
intro.s3Body: Shields protect your streak and nobody scolds you. It works offline and without an account.
intro.s2Done: +10 XP! That's how you grow, one step at a time.
intro.s3Note: If you skip a day, a shield protects your streak. No scolding.

onboarding.quizIntro: Eight light questions to find the hero who's most like you. It's not a serious test!

name.title: What does {hero} call you?
name.label: Your name
name.hint: It stays on this device only.

quests.addPlaceholder: E.g. Drink a glass of water
quests.none: You can also start with no quests and create them later.

onboarding.back: Go back to the previous step

choose.title: Choose your hero
choose.subtitle: Each one has a voice, a story and a style. You can change whenever you like: your level stays yours.
choose.pickFirst: Tap a hero to get to know them

focus.title: What do you want to work on?
focus.subtitle: Pick up to {max} areas and I'll suggest fitting quests. You can skip and change everything later.

rhythm.title: Your rhythm
rhythm.subtitle: When you want to hear from {hero}, and when your day ends.
rhythm.dayEndHint: Until then quests still count for the previous day: staying up late won't cost you your streak at midnight.
rhythm.timesHint: At most two messages a day, never at night. The times only apply if you turn on reminders in the next step.

ready.title: All set, {name}!
ready.subtitle: {hero} is waiting for you.
ready.notifOff: Reminders off: you can turn them on in Settings
ready.questsNone: No quests for now: create them whenever you like

settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Your name
settings.dayStartHint: Until this hour the previous day still counts: staying up late won't cost you your streak at midnight.
settings.dataHint: Everything is saved only on this device. Export a backup to keep it safe.
settings.importPreviewBody: It will replace your current data. A safety copy of the current data will be kept.

importErrors.not_json: The file is not valid JSON.
importErrors.not_backup: The file is not a Questling backup.
importErrors.too_new: This backup comes from a newer version of the app.
importErrors.invalid: The backup is damaged or invalid: your data has not been touched.

settings.recoveredBody: I couldn't read the saved data. I kept a copy and started again from scratch.
settings.privacyBody: Questling has no accounts required, no ads and no tracking. Your data stays on this device and is not sent to anyone.
settings.wipeBody: Profile, quests, XP and story will be erased from this device. It cannot be undone: export a backup first if you want to keep them.
settings.notificationsEnableHint: At most two a day, in your hero's voice.
settings.streakRisk: Alert when your streak is at risk
settings.comeback: A hello if you don't open the app for a few days
settings.quietHours: Out of respect, notifications always arrive between 8:00 and 22:00.
settings.permissionPrompt: To send you reminders I need permission to send notifications.
settings.permissionDenied: Notifications are blocked by the system. The app still works: if you change your mind, enable them in your phone's settings (Apps > Questling > Notifications).
settings.permissionWeb: Reminders work in the installed app on Android or iOS, not in the browser.
settings.languageHint: This also changes the language of your hero and their messages.

notify.title: {hero} would like to keep you company
notify.list1: At most 2 messages a day: one in the morning, one in the evening.
notify.list2: An alert only if your streak is about to break, plus weekly and monthly summaries.
notify.list3: Never scolding, never messages at night. You can change everything in Settings.
notify.skipNote: No problem: the app works just the same and you can turn them on whenever you like in Settings.
notify.webNote: In the browser reminders can't be sent: they'll work in the installed app.

heroUnlock.title: New hero unlocked!
